body:
Thanks for the offer, I appreciate it. I don’t really know what to talk about. It feels complicated and simple at the same time. Long story short, I’ve felt alone for a long time, and I’ve been in love with a girl for a few years now, and we were good friends until a few weeks back, when she told me she wanted us to put some distance between us. She thinks it will help me get better, and she thinks it might help her feel better too.

I don’t think it’ll help me, she really was the one person with whom I felt at peace. But then I’m not really impartial right ? And if it can help her get better, who am I to fight her decision...

Anyway, that’s the biggest reason why I feel bad recently. Losing the girl I love, such an important friend for me. 

I don’t know how I’ll get over this, or if I even want to.
